notes.title: S.O.L. illuminates the Steam Summer Sale with a 50% discount!
notes.content: [p][b]S.O.L. Search Of Light[/b] is participating in the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] with a tempting [b]50% discount[/b]![/p][p] [/p][p]Find your way out in this dark fantasy strategy game set in a steampunk world. With the help of the robots inhabiting this underground place and your resource management skills, it’s time for you to look for an exit and find the surface. Can you make it out of the darkness?[/p][p] [/p][p]Make sure you get it before the sale ends on [b]July 10th[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413470/SOL_Search_of_Light/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
